name: Grade 8 IIIT Summative: App Design
description: Ten core third-trimester words for the Grade 8 app design vocabulary table.

words.definition: Breaking a big task into smaller parts.
words.example: The team used decomposition to split the app into screens, buttons, and events.

words.definition: A person who uses a product or system.
words.example: The user needed a clear button to submit the form.

words.definition: One view or page in an app.
words.example: The app changed to the results screen after the quiz ended.

words.definition: Something that starts an action in a program.
words.example: A click event started the timer in the app.

words.definition: Text, taps, clicks, or choices a user gives to an app.
words.example: The text typed by the user became the app input.

words.definition: The message, score, screen change, or result an app shows.
words.example: The score message was the app output after the user answered.

words.definition: A program designed for a user task.
words.example: The app helped users practice vocabulary with buttons and feedback.

words.definition: A part the user can press.
words.example: The button moved the user from the start screen to the game screen.

words.definition: A value that can change in a program.
words.example: The score variable increased after each correct answer.

words.definition: A response from the app or a tester that helps the user improve.
words.example: The app gave feedback by showing Correct or Try again.
